content: We define character space as the character representations within the HLA latent space (see Figure FIGREF4), and the set $C = \lbrace c_1,c_2,...,c_n\rbrace $ as the set of all characters. We define Observation (OBS) as the input that is fed into any dialogue model. This can be a single or multiple lines of dialogue along with other information. The goal of the dialogue model is to find the best response to this OBS.
